questions.prompt: Which dependence can renaming registers remove?
options: Write after read and write after write
Memory dependences between a store and a load to the same address
questions.explanation: Anti and output dependences exist only because a name is reused.

questions.prompt: In list scheduling, what's a good priority for an instruction?
options: The longest latency path from it to the end of the block

questions.prompt: One warp, in-order issue: ld.global %x (latency 400) then add %y, %x, 1 immediately after. Roughly how many cycles until the add can issue?
questions.explanation: It waits for the load's full latency.

questions.prompt: Why can't a scheduler move ld.global %r, Y[%o + 1] above st.global Y[%o], %q without more analysis?
options: Both access Y: unless it proves the addresses differ, the load might need the stored value
questions.explanation: Memory dependences need alias analysis to break.

questions.prompt: What's the catch when a schedule hoists many loads early?
options: Longer live ranges: more registers, possibly lower occupancy or spills
questions.explanation: Scheduling and register allocation pull against each other.
